description: Downstream schema contract for Indian AI Voice Agent & Telephony Voicemail Ingestion

call_id.name: call_id
call_id.description: Unique identifier for the telephony voice session

customer_name.name: customer_name
customer_name.description: Full name of the caller or customer

language_code.name: language_code
language_code.description: Detected spoken language (e.g. hi-IN, en-IN, hinglish, ta-IN, te-IN, mr-IN)

call_timestamp.name: call_timestamp
call_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 call initiation timestamp with IST offset

duration_seconds.name: duration_seconds
duration_seconds.description: Total call connected duration in seconds

call_intent.name: call_intent
call_intent.description: Categorized intent of the voicemail or conversation

voicemail_transcript.name: voicemail_transcript
voicemail_transcript.description: Automated STT transcript of voicemail or conversation in Hinglish/English/Indic

stt_confidence.name: stt_confidence
stt_confidence.description: Speech-to-Text model confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0

sentiment.name: sentiment
sentiment.description: Sentiment score: positive, neutral, negative, urgent

resolution_status.name: resolution_status
resolution_status.description: Resolution status: resolved_by_ai, voicemail_saved, escalated_to_human, callback_scheduled

cost_inr.name: cost_inr
cost_inr.description: Telephony compute and carrier cost in Indian Rupees (INR)
